# Stage 05: Reconcile

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent) on behalf of Agno JF

After the mandatory post-review PM approval checkpoint, apply only authorized changes to canonical control-root records and close the process run.

## Inputs

| Source | Section or file | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Prior stages | Process brief, evidence package, draft output, review record, approval request | Complete run and proposed change |
| User or PM | Explicit post-review direction, approval, rejection, or requested revision | Authority to enter Stage 05 and scope its changes |
| Control root | `project-control.md`, `process-register.md`, `artifact-index.md`, registers, indexed artifacts | Canonical records |
| Reference | `references/artifact-rules.md`, `references/authority-rules.md`, `references/state-transitions.md` | Reconciliation limits |
| Reference | `references/artifact-management/disposition-rules.md`, `dependency-rules.md` | Approved artifact treatment and dependency limits |

## Process

1. Confirm that Stage 04 presented the approval request and that a later PM response explicitly authorizes Stage 05. The initial process request and a quality pass are not sufficient.
2. If the checkpoint response is absent or unclear, stop before writing Stage 05 output and leave the run `Governance pending`.
3. Confirm the run has no blocking quality failure.
4. Match each proposed change to the approved scope and explicit PM direction when authority is required.
5. Write only approved control-root artifacts, registers, index entries, or process state.
6. Apply artifact-index changes only for the approved artifact IDs and treatments. Preserve existing source locations and do not create duplicate carriers.
7. Leave unauthorized items as `Proposed` or `Governance pending` with the missing direction recorded.
8. Record paths, before and after state, source evidence, direction, and date in the reconciliation record.
9. Update the run manifest with the final state. Never overwrite a prior run.

## Outputs

| Artifact | Location | Format |
|---|---|---|
| Reconciliation record | `{{RUN_PATH}}/stages/05-reconcile/reconciliation-record.md` | Markdown |
| Updated canonical records | `<control-root>/` | Existing Markdown records only |

## Validation

| Check | Pass condition |
|---|---|
| Authority | Every sensitive change has explicit direction |
| Checkpoint | A post-review PM approval is recorded before any Stage 05 write |
| Traceability | Each canonical change links to the run and evidence |
| Artifact index | Need, treatment, owner, location, status, trigger, and verification state reflect approved direction |
| Preservation | External source documents are unchanged |
| State | Process and register states reflect actual direction and evidence |
| Audit | Reconciliation record lists changes, skipped changes, and next trigger |
